label: Trump cracks a whip and tames the dragon over the Panama Canal
description: A red dragon flapping its wings over the Panama Canal amid great corruption there, tamed and made to retreat by the American president cracking a whip. Two dragons are seen, a larger for China and a smaller for North Korea, named as a representation of communism, with an extension reaching across the sea toward Washington through the Democratic party. The communistic spirit over America is said to be broken for a season.
aliases: as Donald Trump cracks his whip he will tame the dragon
a red dragon flapping its wings on the Panama Canal

label: The Golden Gate Bridge taken out by men posing as utility workers
description: Men in hard hats made to look like construction or utility workers checking on the bridge, who take out the whole of the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco, seen arriving by plane from the direction of China.
aliases: the major golden great Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco
they took the whole thing out
made to look like they were construction workers

label: Thousands of North Korean soldiers moved to Russia in boxcars
description: Thousands of North Korean men seen in train cars being taken from North Korea to Russia for the war, rejoicing to be leaving the regime, and then perishing on the battlefield because they are not trained enough. Given 28 and 29 December 2024.
aliases: thousands of North Korean men in train cars
box Cars full of soldiers from North Korea

label: Files and computers burned in Ukraine before the handover
description: Documents and files burned and computers destroyed in Ukraine before the incoming administration arrives, to cover up what was done behind closed doors. Repeated across December 2024.
aliases: I saw them burning files in Ukraine

label: Robots fight the battles instead of soldiers
description: Drone use becoming mainstream and then robots fighting battles like the Terminator, with soldiers no longer put on the field. Given 18 December 2024.
aliases: they'll have robots out fighting battles
they won't even put soldiers on the field
